title: DBP-X: classical DBP with the whole-line dispersion added back (Xiao 2025 form) vs the windowed DBP of E028
question: (1) Is the DBP of E018/E028 a classical DBP (does the first Kerr see the dispersed signal)? (2) Does DBP-X (D_total, then Ns x [linear step, Kerr phase]) beat the E028 DBP at the same RM: at the start without training and after training (one stage vs two stages of Xiao), with 10 seeds?

link.source: из литературы (Bogdanov, Sidelnikov 2021), не проверено на генераторе
link.c_step: c = s * beta2 * (2000 km / Ns) * Rs^2 / 2 (c_total = -21.5 rad); dz = 2000 km / Ns, Ns is defined for the whole link
link.memory_total_symbols: 4 pi |c_total| = 270 (the task text estimated about 135; the formula 2 pi |beta2| Rs^2 L gives 270)
link.note: the multiplier of c_total (0.8-1.2) and the sign are chosen on validation (stage start)

edge.why: filters act on a whole file as circular convolutions; the files are close to periodic (probe on 8 validation files: 74-85 % at the first/last 256 symbols vs 87 % in the middle, Ns = 40); the main metric uses [512, T-512) and raw BER on the same region; centres of window 31 are reported too

gain: complex output gain a = <tx,tx>/<tx,z> (unbiased); start: fitted on validation (one complex number; selection only by validation), training: least squares on train at the start, then learned

unit_test.exact: alpha = 0, exact FFT filters: max |out - rx| < 1e-9 and BER equal to raw for Ns in {1, 8, 20, 40, 80}, both signs; hard: no training if it fails
unit_test.truncated: alpha = 0, symmetric FIR(L) steps from the physical taps, then L_D pretraining (Adam 1e-3, 3000 iterations, the state with the lowest L_D kept): trainable only if |BER reduction| <= 2 pp; configs (Ns, L) = (10,31),(20,31),(40,31),(20,15),(40,15),(20,127),(40,127),(20,255),(40,255),(80,255)
unit_test.smoke_result: exact identity holds; L = 31 and 15 fail by -500 ... -3000 % (truncation: the periodic response exp(i c nu^2) has a kink at nu = +-pi, taps decay as 1/n^2 and the error of the Ns equal steps adds coherently - моё предположение, consistent with the probe); L = 255 passes at Ns = 20, 40

start.g_coarse: 25 values in [-1.2, 1.2], then 9 around the best
start.g: total nonlinear phase scale: alpha per step = g * shape / (Ns * mean |rx|^2)

alpha_kinds.ridge: R = 7, shape of the symmetrized -Im C_{0,j} of E039 coef_M15 (ridge on the 30 train files), sum normalized to 1

start.choice: per (Ns, sign, kernel) the minimum validation MSE (trimmed region); test reported at the choice
start.honest_length: at the choice, FIR of a step in {31,63,127,255,511,1023} and D_total in {271,301,351,401,511,1023} (inverse DTFT truncated); honest length = the shortest within 0.5 pp of the exact filter on validation; test with both honest lengths; RM uses them
start.zero_alpha: (a) alpha = 0 is the identity: BER = raw (unit test)

training.two: physical taps, L_D pretraining (Adam 1e-3, 3000), then MSE with Adam 1e-4 (Xiao)
training.delta: FIR delta, alpha 0 (the E028 initialization in the DBP-X chain), Ns = 20, L = 255 only

train.gate: only (Ns, L) that pass the truncated unit test
train.batch: 4 whole train files per iteration, random circular shift, MSE on all symbols
train.selection: checkpoint with the minimum validation MSE (trimmed); test reported there (test_reduction_valbest_select)
train.plateau: first evaluation within 0.5 pp of the best validation reduction
train.sign_mult: per Ns from the classical row of start_best (validation)

ref.what: windowed DBP of E028 (window 31, FIR delta, alpha 0, sym), the same recipe as E028 grid a

rm.project: direct symmetric FIR 2(L+1) (model_zoo.macs_phys) for D_total and every step, Kerr phase 2 + (R+1)/2 + 4
rm.xiao: Xiao 2025: C_conv(k) = 4 min_T T(log2 T + 1)/(T - k + 1); C_conv(D_total) + Ns (C_conv(L) + 2) for R = 1, Ns (C_conv(L) + C_conv(R)/4 + 6) for R > 1
rm.merged: xiao with D_total and the first linear step merged (one filter of length k_total + L - 1)
rm.e028: project: Ns * macs_phys(R, L, sym) (E028); xiao column for E028: Ns (C_conv(L) + C_conv(R)/4 + 6)

rule_draft.audit: if the first Kerr of E018/E028/E046 acts on the CDC signal without a dispersion block, write 'DBP E028 это не классический DBP'
rule_draft.start_signal: DBP-X at the start (no training) shows a signal against the E028 DBP if its test reduction (honest lengths) exceeds the E028 mean at the nearest RM (xiao column for both) by more than 2 std of E028 (and 2 SE); one start value per config (no seeds), so only the E028 spread enters
rule_draft.train_signal: a trained DBP-X arm beats the E028 reference at the same or lower RM if mean test difference > 2 SE (SE = sqrt(s1^2/n1 + s2^2/n2), 10 seeds each) AND > 2 std (max of the two std); one stage vs two stages: the same rule; convergence: plateau iteration, mean over seeds
rule_draft.not_proven: otherwise 'не доказано'; literature statements (Xiao: two stages better, K = 0/1 optimum) are only hypotheses on our data
rule_draft.limits: one channel, one polarization, 1 sps simulation; files close to periodic, so circular processing is a property of the data; Rs and beta2 from literature (the multiplier is fitted on validation)

value_filter.changes_next_step: yes: a signal opens task 4 (DBP-X + off-axis triplets) and replaces E028 as the DBP reference
value_filter.answered_in_literature: structure yes (Xiao 2025, Liang-Kumar 2014); not on our data
value_filter.needed_for_main_claim: yes: the DBP reference of all RM comparisons
value_filter.cheaper_without_training: stage start answers the main question without training

decision_if_positive: E028 is replaced by DBP-X as the DBP reference; task 4 after E051 (A_LK)
decision_if_negative: report 'не доказано', keep E028 as the reference
eval_rule: validation and (report-only) test every max(500, steps/40) steps; selection only by validation
